title: Harbison Protection Contracts Sales Grid: Purchase Channels, Aftermarket Terms and Units Covered
content:
Harbison Protection Contracts reach a holder through up to three purchase channels: with the installation, within a window after the installation, or on existing equipment after an inspection (the aftermarket channel). This grid sets, tier by tier, which channels are open and on what terms.

**Channels open by tier.**

| Tier | With installation | After installation (no inspection) | Aftermarket (inspected existing equipment) | Equipment must have been installed by Harbison |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Harbison 2-Year Workmanship Warranty | yes (issued, never bought) | no | no | yes |
| Harbison 5-Year Labor Protection | yes | yes | yes | no |
| Harbison 10-Year Labor Protection | yes | yes | yes | no |
| Harbison 10-Year Parts & Labor Protection | yes | yes | yes | no |
| Harbison 12-Year Total Protection | yes | yes | no | yes |
| Harbison 12-Year Total Protection Plus | yes | no | no | yes |

**Window and aftermarket terms.**

| Tier | Post-installation purchase window | Aftermarket purchase allowed | Oldest equipment age for aftermarket | Aftermarket inspection fee | Aftermarket waiting period |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Harbison 2-Year Workmanship Warranty | 0 days (not offered) | no | 0 years | $0.00 | 0 days |
| Harbison 5-Year Labor Protection | 365 days | yes | 7 years | $129.00 | 30 days |
| Harbison 10-Year Labor Protection | 365 days | yes | 5 years | $129.00 | 30 days |
| Harbison 10-Year Parts & Labor Protection | 365 days | yes | 3 years | $129.00 | 30 days |
| Harbison 12-Year Total Protection | 180 days | no | 0 years | $0.00 | 0 days |
| Harbison 12-Year Total Protection Plus | 0 days (not offered) | no | 0 years | $0.00 | 0 days |

- The post-installation window is counted in calendar days after a Harbison installation is completed; 0 means the tier is not offered that way.
- The oldest equipment age is counted from the equipment's install date; 0 years is shown where the aftermarket channel is not offered.
- The aftermarket waiting period is the calendar days after an aftermarket purchase before coverage starts.

**Eligible brands for aftermarket purchase.** On the Harbison 5-Year Labor Protection, the Harbison 10-Year Labor Protection and the Harbison 10-Year Parts & Labor Protection: Carrier, Bryant, Trane, American Standard, Lennox, Rheem, Ruud, Goodman, Amana, York and Daikin. The other three tiers list no aftermarket brands.

**Purchased contracts per unit.** On every tier, 1 purchased protection contract may be in force on one unit at the same time.

**Hypothetical illustration.** Equipment of an eligible brand installed six years ago is within the 7-year aftermarket age of the Harbison 5-Year Labor Protection but beyond the 5-year age of the Harbison 10-Year Labor Protection and the 3-year age of the Harbison 10-Year Parts & Labor Protection.
